result.title: Conflict-Aware Logit Adapters for Utility-Preserving Anti-Distillation
result.summary: While reasoning traces improve model capability, they also provide supervision signals for downstream distillation. Initial efforts to mitigate this issue rely on decoding-time interventions, but they incur high inference overhead and can harm the teacher model's natural fluency. We propose Conflict-Aware Logit Adapters (CALA), a lightweight training-time defense. CALA attaches a small residual adapter to a frozen teacher model and trains only the adapter. A proxy student identifies positions where imitation is most sensitive, and the adapter perturbs the output distribution at these positions while remaining within high-probability regions. A conflict-aware optimization strategy balances anti-distillation and utility objectives, while regularization preserves the teacher's performance and fluency. At inference time, CALA incurs modest overhead and requires no auxiliary model. Experiments on reasoning benchmarks show that CALA substantially reduces successful student imitation while maintaining near-original teacher performance and generation quality. These results establish CALA as a practical and efficient alternative to decoding-time approaches.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CALA：在冻结教师模型上挂接小型残差 adapter 并只训练该 adapter，借助代理学生定位最易被模仿的位置，对这些位置的输出分布做仍处于高概率区的扰动，并用冲突感知优化平衡防蒸馏与效用。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文并非 VLM 或 latent 推理研究，但「代理模型定位敏感位置 + 效用约束下的残差干预」可能可供核查：能否借同类轻量干预定位并扰动携带答案信息的内部状态，用于贡献分配或信息坍缩诊断。
